Restore GitHub-managed CodeQL/CodeQuality recorded settings and verify final analyses

benchmarks.capacity_exception: 100k only if a precise unresolved capacity question remains within600s; no automatic retry/matrix/model/network

groups.target: rare-term p95 capture>=20% lower; exact ordered score/span oracle; investigate hot p99>10% or per-query additional memory>12MiB

groups.changes: 32-document replace/delete/insert burst plus repeated same-ID replacement
groups.target: zero automatic dense rebuilds within bounded burst; include train/update/maintenance and exact liveness oracle
72 frozen evidence steps exact support/source/abstention at unchangedk=candidateLimit1; include eligibility scan overhead; no learned QA claim
bounded admission/cancellation ownership/RSS and cold reopen/build costs; errors explicit

report: uncertainty and unmeasured gains; no hardware/model/general utility extrapolation

execution_detail.harness: retrieval_probe.py + retrieval_probe.rs; injected only into task-owned git archive, no production ablation flags
execution_detail.variants: actual a736 baseline, current combined, current with bounded delta dropped after writes, current with eligibility-set/postings planning disabled in archive only
execution_detail.runtime_limit: 600seconds cumulative subprocess wall time including oracle checks and temporal cases; timer kills an over-budget child; no automatic retries
execution_detail.allocation: Same counting System allocator for all variants; requested bytes and calls, parent wait4 RSS; instrumentation included in reported latency
execution_detail.build_profile: test opt-level3/debug0, no optional features; one Cargo build at a time; binary/source hashes and rustc version retained
execution_detail.queries: 32rare+32hot at clean and32-mutation states per variant/round; every result compared as full ordered JSON against exhaustive oracle; mutations followed by normal dense maintenance recommendation
execution_detail.resource_group: 1000-row actual HmsCore create/ingest/train/query/flush/close/reopen per process; separate previously authored resource/cancellation regressions remain correctness gates
execution_detail.temporal: All six frozen scenarios report every failure; diagnostic archive copy only removes per-scenario panic to collect known baseline failures, normal tests unchanged; compare JSON failures/source quotes/abstention over3rounds

external_limits: Hardware device power-loss/Windows ACL evidence when unavailable locally
Independent cryptographic/finite-precision DP review and authenticated checkpoint provenance
Learned-model/native-answer quality with representative inference remains unmeasured
